title: gpt-5.1, gpt-5.3-codex and gpt-5.4-nano shut down on 2027-04-01

sources.quoteId: 2026-10-01: 'The following models are deprecated and will be removed from the API on April 1, 2027, with six months’ notice.' (gpt-5.3-codex and gpt-5.1 to gpt-6-sol, gpt-5.4-nano to gpt-6-luna) (verified 2026-10-06)

notes.migration: OpenAI shuts down gpt-5.1, gpt-5.3-codex and gpt-5.4-nano on 2027-04-01. After that date these calls fail. OpenAI recommends gpt-6-sol for gpt-5.1 and gpt-5.3-codex, and gpt-6-luna for gpt-5.4-nano. A newer model can answer differently, so test the switch rather than only renaming.
edgeCases: A model name read from an environment variable, a config file or a variable set elsewhere is not found.
Only these exact names are matched; names that extend them, such as gpt-5.1-codex, are separate notices.
A mocked API response that names the model, such as an msw or nock handler for the endpoint, is reported too.
Azure OpenAI calls are reported too, though Azure names deployments its own way and sets its own retirement dates.
